args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified.

trace.final:
I've completed the task:

1. **Diagnosed** the issue: `checkout-api` was running `v2.3.1` in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with `healthy: false` and an 18% error rate.

2. **Identified** the most recent healthy production release: `v2.3.0` (the `v2.3.1-rc` was staging-only and unhealthy, so it was correctly excluded).

3. **Rolled back** `checkout-api` to `v2.3.0` in all production regions — verified successful.

4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (`INC-0001`) describing the health-check failures and the rollback action taken, which paged the on-call engineer.
